title: Energies of a circular orbit
caption: In a circular orbit K = GMm/2r, U = −GMm/r and E = −GMm/2r = −K. Raising the 500 kg satellite from 7000 to 8000 km changes E by +1.78 GJ: the potential energy rises by 3.56 GJ but the kinetic energy falls by 1.78 GJ.
alt: Graph of energy in gigajoules against orbital radius in thousands of kilometres: U falls steeply, K is positive and half its size, and the total E is minus K. Values at 7000 and 8000 km are marked.
description: The horizontal axis is the orbit radius in thousands of km; the vertical axis is energy in GJ for the 500 kg satellite.
U = −GMm/r = −199.3/r (r in 10³ km) is the lowest curve; K = +99.7/r is half its size and opposite in sign; E = K + U = −99.7/r lies between them.

checks.name: U = -24.91 GJ at 8000 km, twice E
